title: refactor(nodes): BusSplitter3D renders from props alone (#373, 4 of 6)

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest'
+import ReactThreeTestRenderer from '@react-three/test-renderer'
+import type { Mesh } from 'three'
+import { BusComponentRenderer } from './BusComponentRenderer'
+import { computeBusPinLayout } from '@/components/scene/busBodyLayout'
+import { circuitActions, useCircuitStore } from '@/store/circuitStore'
+import type { BusComponent, CircuitStore } from '@/store/types'
+import { snapToGrid } from '@/utils/grid'
+import { resetCircuitStore } from '@/test/r3f/seedCircuit'
+
+type Renderer = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof ReactThreeTestRenderer.create>>
+
+const WATCHED = [
+  'selectBus',
+  'setDragActive',
+  'updatePlacementPreviewPosition',
+  'updateBusComponentPosition',
+] as const
+
+let calls: unknown[][] = []
+let renderer: Renderer | undefined
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetCircuitStore()
+  useCircuitStore.setState({
+    placementMode: null,
+    nodePlacementMode: null,
+    junctionPlacementMode: null,
+    busPlacementMode: null,
+    isDragActive: false,
+    placementPreviewPosition: null,
+  })
+  calls = []
+  for (const name of WATCHED) {
+    const original = circuitActions[name] as (...args: unknown[]) => void
+    vi.spyOn(circuitActions, name).mockImplementation(((...args: unknown[]) => {
+      calls.push([name, ...args])
+      original(...args)
+    }))
+  }
+})
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  await renderer?.unmount()
+  renderer = undefined
+  vi.restoreAllMocks()
+})
+
+type Handlers = Pick<Parameters<typeof BusComponentRenderer>[0], 'onClick' | 'onPinClick'>
+
+async function mount(component: BusComponent, handlers: Handlers = {}): Promise<Renderer> {
+  renderer = await ReactThreeTestRenderer.create(<BusComponentRenderer component={component} {...handlers} />)
+  return renderer
+}
+
+const meshesWith = (r: Renderer, geometryType: string) =>
+  r.scene.findAll((n) => n.type === 'Mesh' && (n.instance as Mesh).geometry.type === geometryType)
+const body = (r: Renderer) => meshesWith(r, 'BoxGeometry')[0]
+const pins = (r: Renderer) => meshesWith(r, 'SphereGeometry')
+const inAct = (change: () => void) => ReactThreeTestRenderer.act(() => Promise.resolve(change()))
+
+function addSplitter(): BusComponent {
+  const splitter = useCircuitStore.getState().placeBusSplitter(4, { x: 2, y: 0.2, z: 2 })
+  if (!splitter) throw new Error('splitter not placed')
+  return splitter
+}
+
+describe('BusComponentRenderer as the store adapter for BusSplitter3D', () => {
+  it('selects the splitter on pointer-down, drags past the threshold and drops it at the snapped position', async () => {
+    const splitter = addSplitter()
+    const start = splitter.position
+    const r = await mount(splitter)
+
+    await r.fireEvent(body(r), 'onPointerDown', { point: { x: 2, y: 0.2, z: 2 }, nativeEvent: { pointerId: 1, target: null } })
+    expect(calls).toEqual([['selectBus', splitter.id]])
+
+    await r.fireEvent(body(r), 'onPointerMove', { point: { x: 6.1, y: 0.2, z: 2 } })
+    const preview = snapToGrid({ x: start.x + 4.1, y: start.y, z: start.z })
+    expect(calls.slice(1)).toEqual([
+      ['selectBus', splitter.id],
+      ['setDragActive', true],
+      ['updatePlacementPreviewPosition', preview],
+    ])
+
+    await r.fireEvent(body(r), 'onPointerUp')
+    expect(calls.slice(4)).toEqual([
+      ['setDragActive', false],
+      ['updateBusComponentPosition', splitter.id, preview],
+      ['updatePlacementPreviewPosition', null],
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('binds no drag to the body while a bus component is being placed, and binds it again after cancelBusPlacement', async () => {
+    const r = await mount(addSplitter())
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerDown).toBeTypeOf('function')
+
+    await inAct(() => useCircuitStore.getState().startBusPlacement('joiner'))
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerDown).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerMove).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerUp).toBeUndefined()
+
+    await inAct(() => useCircuitStore.getState().cancelBusPlacement())
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerDown).toBeTypeOf('function')
+  })
+
+  it('binds no drag to the body while a wire is being drawn, and binds it again after cancelWiring', async () => {
+    const r = await mount(addSplitter())
+    const source = useCircuitStore.getState().addInputNode('src', { x: 10, y: 0.2, z: 10 })
+
+    await inAct(() => useCircuitStore.getState().startWiringFromNode(source.id, 'input', { x: 10.6, y: 0.2, z: 10 }))
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerDown).toBeUndefined()
+
+    await inAct(() => useCircuitStore.getState().cancelWiring())
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerDown).toBeTypeOf('function')
+  })
+
+  it.each<[string, Partial<CircuitStore>]>([
+    ['a gate is being placed', { placementMode: 'Nand' }],
+    ['a node is being placed', { nodePlacementMode: 'INPUT' }],
+    ['a junction is being placed', { junctionPlacementMode: true }],
+  ])('keeps the drag bound to the body while %s', async (_, mode) => {
+    const r = await mount(addSplitter())
+
+    await inAct(() => useCircuitStore.setState(mode))
+
+    expect(body(r).props.onPointerDown).toBeTypeOf('function')
+  })
+
+  it('passes a body click to onClick and a pin click to onPinClick, calling no circuitActions', async () => {
+    const splitter = addSplitter()
+    const onClick = vi.fn()
+    const onPinClick = vi.fn()
+    const r = await mount(splitter, { onClick, onPinClick })
+
+    await r.fireEvent(body(r), 'onPointerOver')
+    await r.fireEvent(body(r), 'onClick')
+    await r.fireEvent(pins(r)[0], 'onClick')
+    await r.fireEvent(body(r), 'onPointerOut')
+
+    const slot = computeBusPinLayout(splitter)[0]
+    expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(onPinClick).toHaveBeenCalledWith(splitter.id, slot.pinId, 'input', {
+      x: splitter.position.x + slot.position[0],
+      y: splitter.position.y + slot.position[1],
+      z: splitter.position.z + slot.position[2],
+    })
+    expect(calls).toEqual([])
+  })
+})

+import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
+import type { ComponentProps } from 'react'
+import ReactThreeTestRenderer from '@react-three/test-renderer'
+import { Color, type Mesh, type MeshStandardMaterial } from 'three'
+import { BusSplitter3D } from './BusSplitter3D'
+import { createBusPins } from '@/simulation/busPins'
+import { computeBusPinLayout } from '@/components/scene/busBodyLayout'
+import { colors } from '@/theme'
+import type { DragBinding } from '@/gates/types'
+import type { BusComponent } from '@/store/types'
+
+vi.mock('@/store/circuitStore', () => {
+  const noStore = () => {
+    throw new Error('BusSplitter3D read the store')
+  }
+  return {
+    useCircuitStore: Object.assign(noStore, { getState: noStore }),
+    circuitActions: new Proxy({}, { get: noStore }),
+  }
+})
+
+vi.mock('@/hooks/useBusDrag', () => ({
+  useBusDrag: () => {
+    throw new Error('BusSplitter3D read gesture state')
+  },
+}))
+
+vi.mock('@/components/canvas/FloatingLabel', () => ({
+  FloatingLabel: ({ text }: { text: string }) => <group name={`label:${text}`} />,
+}))
+
+type Renderer = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof ReactThreeTestRenderer.create>>
+
+function makeSplitter(width = 4): BusComponent {
+  const { inputs, outputs } = createBusPins('splitter', width)
+  return { id: 'bus-1', kind: 'splitter', position: { x: 1, y: 0.2, z: 2 }, rotation: { x: 0, y: 0, z: 0 }, width, inputs, outputs, selected: false }
+}
+
+const mounted: Renderer[] = []
+
+async function mount(overrides: Partial<ComponentProps<typeof BusSplitter3D>> = {}): Promise<Renderer> {
+  const renderer = await ReactThreeTestRenderer.create(<BusSplitter3D component={makeSplitter()} {...overrides} />)
+  mounted.push(renderer)
+  return renderer
+}
+
+function meshesWith(renderer: Renderer, geometryType: string) {
+  return renderer.scene.findAll(
+    (node) => node.type === 'Mesh' && (node.instance as Mesh).geometry.type === geometryType,
+  )
+}
+
+const body = (renderer: Renderer) => meshesWith(renderer, 'BoxGeometry')[0]
+const pins = (renderer: Renderer) => meshesWith(renderer, 'SphereGeometry')
+const material = (mesh: ReturnType<typeof body>) => (mesh.instance as Mesh).material as MeshStandardMaterial
+const hex = (colour: string) => new Color(colour).getHexString()
+const labels = (renderer: Renderer) =>
+  renderer.scene.findAll((node) => node.instance.name.startsWith('label:')).map((node) => node.instance.name)
+
+function fakeDrag(overrides: Partial<DragBinding> = {}): DragBinding {
+  return {
+    isDragging: false,
+    shouldAllowClick: () => true,
+    onPointerDown: vi.fn(),
+    onPointerMove: vi.fn(),
+    onPointerUp: vi.fn(),
+    onPointerLeave: vi.fn(),
+    ...overrides,
+  }
+}
+
+afterEach(async () => {
+  for (const renderer of mounted.splice(0)) await renderer.unmount()
+})
+
+describe('BusSplitter3D under test-renderer, with no store and no gesture state', () => {
+  it('draws the body, one pin per bus pin and the SPLIT label from props alone', async () => {
+    const renderer = await mount()
+
+    expect(meshesWith(renderer, 'BoxGeometry')).toHaveLength(1)
+    expect(pins(renderer)).toHaveLength(5)
+    expect(labels(renderer)).toEqual(['label:SPLIT x4'])
+  })
+
+  it('colours the body by hover and selection, and each pin by its value', async () => {
+    const splitter = makeSplitter()
+    splitter.inputs[0].value = 1
+    const renderer = await mount({ component: splitter })
+
+    expect(material(body(renderer)).color.getHexString()).toBe(hex(colors.gate.body))
+    await renderer.fireEvent(body(renderer), 'onPointerOver')
+    expect(material(body(renderer)).color.getHexString()).toBe(hex(colors.gate.bodyHover))
+    await renderer.fireEvent(body(renderer), 'onPointerOut')
+    expect(material(body(renderer)).color.getHexString()).toBe(hex(colors.gate.body))
+
+    expect(pins(renderer).map((pin) => material(pin).color.getHexString())).toEqual([
+      hex(colors.pin.active),
+      ...splitter.outputs.map(() => hex(colors.pin.inactive)),
+    ])
+  })
+
+  it('draws the selected colour when selected', async () => {
+    const renderer = await mount({ selected: true })
+
+    expect(material(body(renderer)).color.getHexString()).toBe(hex(colors.gate.bodySelected))
+  })
+
+  it('reports a body click through onClick and a pin click with its side and world position through onPinClick', async () => {
+    const onClick = vi.fn()
+    const onPinClick = vi.fn()
+    const splitter = makeSplitter()
+    const renderer = await mount({ component: splitter, onClick, onPinClick })
+
+    await renderer.fireEvent(body(renderer), 'onClick')
+    await renderer.fireEvent(pins(renderer)[2], 'onClick')
+
+    const slot = computeBusPinLayout(splitter)[2]
+    expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(onPinClick).toHaveBeenCalledWith('bus-1', slot.pinId, 'output', {
+      x: 1 + slot.position[0],
+      y: 0.2 + slot.position[1],
+      z: 2 + slot.position[2],
+    })
+  })
+
+  it('binds the drag gesture to the body only when canDrag is set', async () => {
+    const drag = fakeDrag()
+    const draggable = await mount({ drag, canDrag: true })
+
+    await draggable.fireEvent(body(draggable), 'onPointerDown')
+    await draggable.fireEvent(body(draggable), 'onPointerMove')
+    await draggable.fireEvent(body(draggable), 'onPointerUp')
+    await draggable.fireEvent(body(draggable), 'onPointerOut')
+    expect(drag.onPointerDown).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(drag.onPointerMove).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(drag.onPointerUp).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(drag.onPointerLeave).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+
+    const lockedDrag = fakeDrag()
+    const locked = await mount({ drag: lockedDrag, canDrag: false })
+    expect(body(locked).props.onPointerDown).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(body(locked).props.onPointerMove).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(body(locked).props.onPointerUp).toBeUndefined()
+    await locked.fireEvent(body(locked), 'onPointerOut')
+    expect(lockedDrag.onPointerLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+    const bare = await mount()
+    expect(body(bare).props.onPointerDown).toBeUndefined()
+  })
+
+  it('drops a body click that the drag binding does not allow', async () => {
+    const onClick = vi.fn()
+    const renderer = await mount({ onClick, drag: fakeDrag({ shouldAllowClick: () => false }) })
+
+    await renderer.fireEvent(body(renderer), 'onClick')
+
+    expect(onClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  it('draws the body translucent and keeps the drag on pointer-out while the binding reports a drag', async () => {
+    const drag = fakeDrag({ isDragging: true })
+    const renderer = await mount({ drag, canDrag: true })
+
+    await renderer.fireEvent(body(renderer), 'onPointerOut')
+
+    expect(material(body(renderer)).transparent).toBe(true)
+    expect(material(body(renderer)).opacity).toBe(0.7)
+    expect(drag.onPointerLeave).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+})
